threshold_rule: Open written-notice repair: at_risk from 5 days, breach_presumed at 7.0 days (Tex. Prop. Code 92.056 seven-day presumption); emergency_watch after 1 day. Rule is a simplification and needs attorney review.
known_failure_modes: Uses submitted_at as notice date; ignores tenant-rent-current and lease-notice conditions; verbal notices excluded; rebuttable presumption is not a legal conclusion.

threshold_rule: z-score of ln(assign hours) vs same category and severity history: high at z>=2, elevated at z>=1; needs enough baseline rows.
known_failure_modes: Small baselines are noisy; planted delay distribution is lognormal by assumption; does not separate vendor from coordinator delay.

inputs: fct_leases + fct_work_orders in the first 90 days
threshold_rule: Score 100 minus 25 for any urgent or emergency request, 5 per request (max 25), 1 per hour of average assignment delay (max 30), 20 if any request open over 7 days. at_risk below 60, watch below 80.
known_failure_modes: Window (90 days) follows Property Meld; point weights are our assumption; no tenant feedback beyond work orders.

inputs: fct_leases early-90 features, offered increase (once offered), s04_coefficients seed
threshold_rule: Logistic model fitted on past decided leases; value is P(non-renewal). high at >=0.55, medium at >=0.40.
known_failure_modes: Effects are planted in the simulator so recovery proves the pipeline not real-world truth; unobserved tenant traits omitted; offer unknown before day 90 before expiry so that term is neutral.

threshold_rule: Average days after due date in last 90 days minus prior 90 days (min 2 payments each): shifting_late at +3 days or more, improving at -3 or less.
known_failure_modes: Catch-up payments for missed months count as late; few payments per window means noisy averages.

threshold_rule: FIFO aging of open charges (rent plus late fees) against payments: oldest unpaid age 4-30 days, 31-60, 61+ days; value is open balance.
known_failure_modes: Assumes payments apply to oldest charge first; ignores deposits and payment plans.

threshold_rule: Unit with no active lease and a prior lease: value is vacant days times last rent per day; elevated above 30 days, high above 45.
known_failure_modes: Last lease rent is a proxy for asking rent; units not yet onboarded are excluded.

threshold_rule: Completion days and cost normalized by category and severity. slow_vs_peers if all-time normalized days >=1.5; drifting if last 90 days vs earlier baseline is up 35 percent or more on days or cost.
known_failure_modes: Normalization ignores job complexity; small samples per vendor; cost is heavy tailed.

threshold_rule: Request in last 30 days with an earlier request for the same unit and category within 30 days: repeat for one, chronic for two or more.
known_failure_modes: Category labels are coarse; a legitimate follow-up visit looks like a repeat.

inputs: ops.load_log, marts null rates, data recency
threshold_rule: Row-count change vs previous load over 10 percent; null rate above allowed maximum for key columns; newest record more than 7 days before the snapshot date.
known_failure_modes: dbt test failures not yet stored in the database; only a few key columns are checked.
